principles: Only fix real correctness issues in status/boundary documentation.
Do not optimize or greenwash status tables for their own sake.
Preserve consistency of logic across Parent Roadmap, Strengthening Roadmap, and Proof Admissibility.
Keep local CLI evidence separate from Authority or production completion claims.
drivers: B-e781 machine evidence now closes B-43de M4-M12 parent rows.
Authority Server receipt-backed proof is being removed from active direction.
The user needs a stable table that distinguishes completed rows from optional/future/retired boundaries.

options.name: A: targeted status-boundary cleanup only
pros: Corrects stale rows without changing runtime behavior
Keeps optional and retired boundaries visible
cons: Does not implement migration automation or Authority proof consumer, which is intentional

options.name: B: implement missing capabilities to make tables all green
cons: Would reintroduce Authority or migration work the user did not ask to build
Higher risk and inconsistent with current system direction

rationale: Choose the targeted cleanup because the real issue is stale and ambiguous document status, not missing runtime implementation.

preMortem.scenario: Parent Roadmap cleanup overclaims full runtime or production completion
preMortem.trigger: Replacing Partial/future with a broad completed claim without B-e781 boundary text
preMortem.consequence: Users may believe more than local bounded M4-M12 closure was proven
preMortem.mitigation: Name B-e781, parent_roadmap_status, and local machine evidence boundaries explicitly

preMortem.scenario: Migration/repair automation is accidentally converted into required work
preMortem.trigger: Treating optional/future migration row as incomplete correctness blocker
preMortem.consequence: Scope expands into implementation work unrelated to the selected cleanup
preMortem.mitigation: Keep migration/repair as optional/future and state it is not required for M4-M12 closure

preMortem.scenario: Authority-facing proof consumer appears as active work despite retired Authority direction
preMortem.trigger: Leaving wording as generic Partial/future production adapter work
preMortem.consequence: Future agents may reopen Authority Server receipt-backed proof work contrary to current direction
preMortem.mitigation: Rewrite as external/retired boundary and keep productionDone=false language
